13e8ba8ed046fc9091257f931cd358c7e0b5623c.summary: A DataBreaches blog update (published 2025-08-12) on the ShinyHunters group. Its main Telegram channel and a backup channel were banned, and a $500,000 bounty in XMR was posted on BreachForums for information on a member called Yukari. The group then claimed BreachForums was compromised and under law enforcement control, which the blog could not verify. BreachForums went offline, and who took it down is unconfirmed. The group threatened a DDoS attack on FalconFeeds, and a new Telegram channel opened.

hedges: DataBreaches is reporting the claims, but has no way of verifying or refuting any of them.
Who took BreachForums down has not been confirmed, and whether a seizure notice will appear is unknown at this time.
Whether the backup channel was banned because of the redacted NCB images, the DDoS threat, or another reason is not known to DataBreaches.
The claims that BreachForums was compromised and under French and U.S. law enforcement control are allegations by the group.
The posted screenshots appear to be redacted requests from U.S. Interpol (NCB) to France, but this is not verified.
The messages appear to be written by Shiny, the group's leader.
A nameserver check did not show any change to government-owned nameservers as of publication.
